construct.diagnosis_or_process: Paroxysmal kinesigenic dyskinesia due to PRRT2 dysfunction
construct.mechanism: Heterozygous PRRT2 variants disturb presynaptic neurotransmitter release and cause brief paroxysmal dyskinesias triggered by sudden voluntary movement. Attacks usually last seconds to under a minute, consciousness is preserved, examination is normal between attacks, and carbamazepine often suppresses events.
construct.primary_system: Behavioral Health, Nervous Systems and Special Senses
construct.primary_competency: Medical Knowledge: Applying Foundational Science Concepts

second_answer_attack.resolution: Carbamazepine can treat seizures, but the attacks are seconds long, obligatorily triggered by sudden voluntary movement, awareness is preserved, EEG is normal, and there is a familial PRRT2 phenotype. That pattern defines paroxysmal kinesigenic dyskinesia.
